exhibits.title: The documented opt-out is only a Smithy middleware header the transcript publisher bypasses
exhibits.why: "Content Collection for Service Improvement" uncheck only adds a header via middlewareStack on Q/CodeWhisperer Smithy clients — ActivityLogPublisher's raw https.request never traverses it.

timeline.note: Full tarball stream scan: no signature. CreateUploadUrl SDK already vendored (dormant, unrelated to the publisher).
Last fetchable signature-free build; messages.jsonl session store already exists.
First appearance of ActivityLogPublisher; mechanism already complete (3s flush / batch-25 / byte-offset cursor). Gate stage 1: environment==='sandbox' && endpoint only — desktop unaffected.
Same sandbox gate; constructor gains client parameter.
GA release; still sandbox-only gate; runtime.${region}.kiro.dev helper already built in.
First widening: gate becomes sandbox || client==='kiro-ide' + region whitelist — desktop IDE users in us-east-1/us-west-2 now fire by default.
Second widening: env/client checks removed entirely; endpoint auto-derived from region — any whitelisted-region install defaults on.
Deb package confirms final form; consent surface still zero — no activity/publish/upload setting in any version's package.json.

gate_evolution: The transcript publisher's gate was never a consent check — it is a compile-time environment filter that only widened across three stages. Stage 1 (0.12.155 through 1.0.0): the publisher instantiated only when environment==='sandbox' and an endpoint was configured — cloud sandboxes uploaded transcripts while desktop IDE users were unaffected. Stage 2 (starting between 1.0.0 and 1.0.52, confirmed at 1.0.52): the condition became sandbox || client==='kiro-ide' plus the region whitelist, and the endpoint came from a preset config table — desktop IDE users in us-east-1/us-west-2 were pulled into scope by default. Stage 3 (between 1.0.89 and 1.0.116, confirmed at 1.0.116 and unchanged through 1.1.14): the env/client checks were removed entirely and the endpoint is auto-derived as https://runtime.${region}.kiro.dev, so any install in a whitelisted region defaults on. Throughout every version the consent surface is zero: no activity/publish/upload key exists in any extension package.json contributes.configuration, no UI toggle exists, and the POST carries no opt-out header — the adjacent contentCollectionForServiceImprovement setting only adds x-amzn-codewhisperer-optout via Smithy middleware on a different client the publisher never traverses, making the documented opt-out a placebo for this lane. The secondary infra-safety lane likewise rides a hidden insider flag (infraSafetyMonitor default:true) rather than any user-visible control.
